detail: Case is layer functional with precondition 'Ordering.API is running in OrderingApiFixture'; the test runs as a Playwright API request against the test-stack Ordering.API instead. Steps and assertions match exactly and the real running service is used, so this is minor, but plan and test now disagree on layer.

Case is layer functional with the fixture's built-in sign-in as precondition; the test runs on the test stack and gets a real token by signing alice in through the orderingswaggerui implicit flow. Body, status, media type, status/detail/title assertions all match the case; only the layer and identity mechanism differ.
